Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-022 - Over-threshold submission creates one linked approval task

parameters.script: const body=document.body.innerText; const hits=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')).filter(e=>{const t=(e.innerText||'').trim(); return t.includes('EXP-1039') && t.includes('EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245') && t.length<1800;}).sort((a,b)=>a.innerText.length-b.innerText.length); const el=hits[0]||null; return {href:location.href,matchCount:hits.length,cardText:el?el.innerText:null,links:el?Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('a,button')).map(x=>({tag:x.tagName,text:(x.innerText||'').trim(),href:x.href||null,aria:x.getAttribute('aria-label')})):[],bodyHasTask:body.includes('101661275')};

parameters.elementDescription: The 'Task #101661275' Action Center task link inside the fresh EXP-1039 approval card in the CENTER-RIGHT area, beneath the card's Receipt row and above the approval reason; it is the task link for EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245, not the neighboring EFREG023 task link on the card to the right.
